entries.title: Upload a file where adding an article failed
entries.body: If the app cannot get an article from its address and suggests uploading it, the same page has a place to choose or drop one file. When a site turns the app away, the message suggests the site's Download PDF button if it has one, otherwise saving the page as a PDF. Help says the same.

entries.title: Arrow keys step through Search matches
entries.body: While Search is open, the left and right arrow keys move to the next or previous match and take the article to it, as they already did in Quotes. The selected match stays in view in the list, and pointing at a match tells you which keys to use.

entries.title: Publication date and journal shown above the article
entries.body: The heading above an article shows the journal it appeared in, when that differs from the site, and its publication date or year where known. Word, part and section counts sit behind a Show counts button. On the Metadata page, Why you're reading has its own section, just after In one sentence.
